generation_method: built-in premium image generation followed by exact 1200x630 resizing and sRGB PNG export
review_method: Every generated draft was inspected individually and in a six-image contact sheet for story fidelity, dominant white background, instructional hierarchy, readable short labels, safe margins, clipping, invented claims, and compositional differentiation. This is assistant editorial QA, not external human review.
criteria: six to twelve or more meaningful story-specific components
no clipping, overlap, distortion or invented claims
no photorealism, realistic people, devices, office scenes, generic robots or stock-photo composition

images.assessment: White canvas dominates; the layered runtime controls, arrows, callouts and stop paths are distinct, legible and inside safe margins.
The white-ground isometric map clearly distinguishes identities, role scopes, action paths and denials without overlap.
